title: Psychedelic Plasma Orb
description: A large transparent spherical orb rests on colorful rocky terrain, containing a glowing purple onion-like structure with dripping viscous liquid. Inside and around the orb are vibrant flowers, red berries, and branching purple plasma tendrils, set against a dramatic sky with swirling red clouds and streaking rainbow light beams.
